newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwe shares end Wednesday active and firm.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwe shares end Wednesday active and firm.

text.p: Zimbabwean shares rose by one percent in active trade on Wednesday, buoyed by improved liquidity flows into the equity market, brokers said.
The key industrial index leapt 119.27 points -- or 1.1 percent -- to close at 10,630.76 and the brokers said they expected it to climb higher on Thursday.
"I think the market will continue bullish. Improved liquidity is still the main factor behind this bullishness," one broker said, adding he was unsure where the money was coming from.

Among industrials on Wednesday, pharmaceutical group Caps and sugar refinery ZSR jumped 100 cents each to 2,900 and 1,600 respectively, finance house Finhold rose 65 cents to 465 and winery Cairns gained 50 cents to 1,500.

Bankers Barclays rose 50 cents to 3,350, merchant bankers NMB and sugar producer Hippo each added 25 cents to 3,325 and 1,675 respectively while discount house DCZ at 200 and cement-maker Circle at 500 both put on 15 cents.
The mining board was quieter but slightly firmer with nickel producer Bindura traded five cents up at 630.
The mining index edged 2.67 points up to 866.57.
